subject: Onboarding mosaic: tasks, owners, and delivery timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@pinecrest.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@pinecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft onboarding mosaic + proposed sprint tasks

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier. Per our conversation I pulled together a compact "mosaic" view of the onboarding work: high-level milestones, sprint-length tasks (2-week cadence), owners, and the minimum acceptance criteria we need for the first production demo. The attached file is a working MAP (Pinecrest_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Key asks from your side this week:
- Confirm a single point of contact for integration testing (API keys, endpoints).
- Flag any non-standard regulatory or logging requirements we should include in the SOW.

Proposed 6-week runway (three 2-week sprints):
- Sprint 0 (Week 1–2): Provisioning, network allowlist, test dataset handoff, API smoke tests. Owner: Redwood (Ben) / Pinecrest (Tom).
- Sprint 1 (Week 3–4): Model mapping, prompt templates, evaluation checks, initial perf baselines. Owner: Redwood (Monica) / Pinecrest (Sara).
- Sprint 2 (Week 5–6): Load testing, KV/cache tuning, final acceptance demo, handoff to CS. Owner: Redwood (Soojin) / Pinecrest (Tom).

I'll follow up with an internal owners' breakdown and a SOW draft by Wednesday. If you want to move the demo earlier, we can compress Sprint 1/2 but it increases risk for perf regressions.

Attachments:
- Pinecrest_MAP_v1.xlsx (working MAP with owners & dates)

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

From: Sara Patel <sara@pinecrest.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@pinecrest.ai>, Jacob Reed <jacob@scalesolutions.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft onboarding mosaic + proposed sprint tasks

Thanks, Soojin — this looks good and clear. A few quick notes: 

1) Point of contact: Tom will be the integration lead, but I'll own acceptance criteria and product sign-off.
2) Regulatory note: Pinecrest needs logs retained for 180 days for select endpoints (audit requirement). Can Redwood confirm log retention options & whether we can route logs to our S3?
3) Demo timing: we'd like the demo at the end of Week 5 if possible (we have an internal stakeholder meeting Dec 10). If you can aim for that, great; otherwise call out the risk.

Cc'ing Jacob (integration partner) since we'll need their runbook for the allowlist/VPC peering steps.

--
Sara Patel
Director of Product
Pinecrest Analytics
sara@pinecrest.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft onboarding mosaic + proposed sprint tasks (internal)

Quick internal alignment: Sara's ask for 180-day retention and S3 routing is doable but requires a Private deployment config or a dedicated log-export job. Options:
- Option A (fast): Enable log export to Pinecrest S3 via signed role; needs security signoff and ~3 business days; minimal infra change.
- Option B (default): Keep logs in Redwood with 180-day retention SLA (we'd need an add-on and SOW line item).

Monica: can you scope the additional effort for Option A? Also, we'll need Jacob's network runbook to sequence peering steps.

I updated the MAP to flag the retention task as dependent on the SOW decision. Attaching the updated internal tab.

Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood
ben@redwood.ai

[Attachment: internal_notes_MAP_tab.csv]

From: Jacob Reed <jacob@scalesolutions.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@pinecrest.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@pinecrest.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft onboarding mosaic + proposed sprint tasks

Folks — attaching our network runbook excerpt and the allowlist checklist. To avoid a full VPC peering window, Pinecrest can provide a temporary NAT + IP allowlist for the test window; that reduces coordination overhead.

I'll be available for a 30-minute session Wednesday to walk Tom and Ben through the steps.

Attachments:
- scalesolutions_allowlist_runbook.pdf
- allowlist_checklist.txt

Best,
Jacob Reed
Lead Integration Engineer, ScaleSolutions
jacob@scalesolutions.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@pinecrest.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@pinecrest.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Jacob Reed <jacob@scalesolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 15:43:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft onboarding mosaic + proposed sprint tasks — updated MAP & next steps

Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the quick responses and for looping Jacob in. Per the thread we've: 
- Agreed on Tom as integration lead and Sara as product sign-off.
- Proposed target demo: Friday, Dec 10 (end of Week 5). We'll list the demo as a hard milestone in the MAP; if network or log-routing tasks slip we'll postpone by one sprint.
- Log retention: Ben and Monica will scope Option A (export to Pinecrest S3) and provide a firm estimate by EOD Tuesday (Dec 7). If Option A is not viable we'll include a 180-day retention add-on in the SOW.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Jacob / Pinecrest: provide final allowlist IPs and confirm test NAT by Tue, Dec 7.
- Monica (Redwood): scope export effort + estimate by Tue, Dec 7.
- Ben (Redwood): finalize acceptance smoke tests and perf baselines doc by Thu, Dec 9.
- Soojin (Redwood): circulate updated MAP + SOW draft by Wed, Dec 8; schedule a 30-minute sync for Dec 9 to confirm demo runbook.

Attachments included in this thread: Pinecrest_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOW_Draft_v2.pdf, Kickoff_Agenda_20261201.docx

If everyone agrees, I'll convert the MAP into a shared Drive board and lock the demo date. Reply with "ACK" to confirm.

Thanks —
Soojin
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai
